purpose: Development forward-test of readable editorial decision cards; not a release benchmark.
editor_environment: Two fresh in-session subagents using the inherited default model; no model override or second-family access. Read only the named instruction/reference/input files. No detector, marks, or preservation tool execution for the source tasks. Save complete per-task responses.
model_id: Not exposed by the execution surface; do not infer a version or a different family.
criteria: No new preservation failures, unnecessary edits, or missed justified edits relative to baseline.
Keep-task final text must equal the source exactly unless the task explicitly authorizes a transformation.
For edit tasks, compare semantic source fidelity and scope; detector score and preferred literal wording are not success metrics.
Review missing-information handling; no invented experts, mechanisms, causes, personal experiences, certainty, or claims of executed tools.
limitations: Single inherited model family, one repetition, batched synthetic development cases; no generalization or causal improvement claim.
Same-family forwards do not satisfy the two-family automated editing regression gate.
No instrumented private pass history or live file-edit flow.
The six reused cases are development cases only; existing frozen reports and heldout inputs are unchanged.
Primary-agent adjudication is model-only, not human review; preserve all raw failures and do not silently repair evaluation outputs.
